biggest_catch: The $150 annual fee eats the bonus: 130,000 Hilton Honors points are worth roughly $650 at ~0.5 cent each, plus a Free Night Reward — so year-one net is about $500 plus the free night, but ONLY if you were already going to spend $3,000 in six months, and the offer ends 1/13/2027.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $3,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
The $150 annual fee eats the bonus: 130,000 points at ~0.5 cent each is ~$650 minus $150 = ~$500 net plus the free night.
This is a limited-time offer ending 1/13/2027 — apply through the offer advertisement before then.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.
Once-per-lifetime rule: you can only earn the Surpass welcome bonus once — not eligible if you have or have had this card.
Amex's eligibility check can deny the welcome offer based on your Card Member history and number of cards opened/closed; you are notified before processing so you can withdraw.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full.

Fees, interest, cash advances, gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments don't count toward the $3,000 threshold; account must not be past due or cancelled at fulfillment; bonus points don't count toward Hilton elite tier qualification.
